repair.semantics: on a full-cache miss, build a valid caller-owned adaptive table and return ok=true without inserting it into the full cache

finding: The bounded adaptive-hydraulic cache is no longer a correctness limit. Capacity overflow degrades to uncached construction, while workloads whose unique working set fits in cache amortize exactly as intended.
remaining_performance_question: Repeated over-capacity workloads may still rebuild uncached parameterizations frequently. This is a performance question, not a correctness issue, and requires a separately preregistered workload study before adding eviction or increasing cache size.
nonclaims: No claim is made yet for workloads with more than 32 repeatedly reused unique hydraulic parameterizations.
No whole-SWAP or MultiSWAP speedup is implied.
